title: Modern Sage Kitchen
description: A stunning sage green kitchen featuring handleless cabinetry, quartz worktops, and integrated Bosch appliances. The design maximises the open-plan layout with a large island unit perfect for entertaining.

title: Master Bedroom Suite
description: A luxurious master bedroom with floor-to-ceiling fitted wardrobes, custom headboard with integrated reading lights, and matching bedside units. The warm oak finish creates an inviting sanctuary.

title: Entertainment Media Wall
description: A striking media wall featuring a 75-inch recessed TV, electric fireplace, ambient LED strips, and hidden cable management. The matt anthracite finish gives a contemporary, cinema-like feel.

title: Walk-in Wardrobe
description: A beautifully organised walk-in wardrobe with dedicated zones for each type of clothing. Features include pull-down hanging rails, illuminated shoe storage, and a jewellery island.

title: Dark Luxury Kitchen
description: A dramatic dark kitchen with charcoal cabinetry, Dekton worktops, and gold-accented hardware. The moody palette is balanced with under-cabinet lighting and a skylight.

title: Contemporary Bedroom
description: A clean, contemporary bedroom with built-in wardrobes that disappear into the wall. The warm white palette with walnut accents creates a calming, minimalist retreat.

title: Classic Fitted Kitchen
description: A timeless Shaker-style kitchen in a rich deep green. Featuring Belfast sink, marble worktops, and open shelving for a classic yet functional design.

title: Living Room Redesign
description: A complete living room transformation featuring a full-width media wall with integrated bio-ethanol fireplace, floating shelves, and hidden storage for games consoles.

title: Luxury Ensuite
description: A hotel-inspired ensuite bedroom and bathroom combination featuring bespoke vanity units, walk-in shower enclosure, and matching bedroom furniture in a calming stone palette.
